claims.text: Wei et al. (2023) demonstrate that parameter-efficient fine-tuning with only 1% trainable parameters can surpass full fine-tuning.
Yi et al. (2024) extend this by decomposing VFM features in frequency space for style-content separation.
Zhang & Tan (2025) bridge VFMs with VLMs using Mamba architectures, achieving linear scalability.
Fahes et al. (2023) use language for style randomization.
Pak et al. (2024) employ text embeddings as domain-invariant object queries.
Zhang & Tan (2025) fuse VLMs with VFMs.
Niu et al. (2024) use text embeddings for controllable style transformation.
Niemeijer et al. (2023) generate pseudo-target domains with text-prompt control.
Jia et al. (2023) create diverse training datasets using LDMs with semantic control.
Yi et al. (2024) use frequency decomposition.
Ahn et al. (2024) employ covariance alignment.
Niu et al. (2024) develop text-driven style transformation with semantic consistency.

Benigmim et al. (2023) and Zhang & Tan (2025) demonstrate that combining multiple foundation models (CLIP, SAM, DINOv2, generative models) yields superior performance compared to single-model approaches.
